cluster.description: Cluster name, exactly as returned by list_clusters.

format.description: Output encoding. table is the cheapest for this tool.

group.description: Restrict to one rule group, matched exactly by name.

includeExpr.description: Include each rule's PromQL expression. Off by default because expressions are long; turn it on when you want to run an alert's own query with query_range.

limit.description: Maximum rules to return, counted across all groups.

ruleName.description: Restrict to one rule, matched exactly by name.
